jobDescription.text:

qualifications.title: Qualifications
qualifications.text:
• Network Engineer with 5 -7 years hands-on experience with large scale networks operation and architecture. 
  • Proven experience with:
    • Cisco Nexus/Arista data center equipment.
    • Cisco Catalyst line network equipment.

    • Cisco ISR, ASR routing platforms.

    • Routing protocols and technologies such as BGP and OSPF.

    • Load balancing technologies (Citrix NetScaler - an advantage).
  • Wireless LAN technologies (Juniper Mist - an advantage).

  • Experience with Cisco ISE / Network Access Control (NAC) is an advantage.

  • Strong knowledge of complex network environments (CCNP certification level).
